text: What plays the role of the synapses (the inter-layer connectivity) in a diffractive neural network?
choices: Metal wires patterned between the layers
Electronic multipliers placed at each pixel
Optical fibers connecting corresponding pixels of adjacent layers
Free-space diffraction (Rayleigh-Sommerfeld propagation), which couples every pixel to every pixel of the next layer with no physical wiring
explanation: Each pixel imposes a local phase, then diffraction spreads its contribution across the entire next layer, realizing an all-to-all (fully connected) map from a single passive slab, with connectivity supplied 'for free' by physics. There are no wires, electronic multipliers, or fibers on the inference path.
